decisions.reason: As a very recent, adjacent experiment in a growing physical-media market, the white-label test vinyl series should be kept because uncertainty about its niche demand is still high while the catalog-based retailer can likely maintain it at relatively low cost.

The German new wave compilation series fits closely with the firm's collector-oriented catalog and, with only one year of market exposure and no clear negative signal, it is worth keeping as a low-cost option until demand becomes clearer.
